hooks.command: bash -c 'set -o pipefail; pnpm typecheck && pnpm test 2>&1 | tail -25' && echo '{"systemMessage": "typechecks and tests passing"}' || exit 2

rm -f .vitest/json/output.json; pnpm test --reporter=json --silent=passed-only >/dev/null 2>&1; jq '[.testResults[].assertionResults[] | select(.status == "failed")]' .vitest/json/output.json | grep -v '^\[\]$' || true
